title: "Maker Movement" Approach to Computing; Advanced Ethical Hacking and Defensive Blue Teaming
description: We will learn how to hack into a Windows machine, utilize powershell, and learn how to get admin access. We will learn how to perform web app testing and test for the most critical web security risks. We will learnabout password cracking, persistence, malware analysis, digital forensics, and threat emulation. The class will provide students with knowledge on how to identify attacking techniques to use in a defensive strategy, and prevent malicious actions from malware files.
